AuthorDetails.Name: Daniel Schmidt
AuthorDetails.Description: Developer focused on useful, editor-friendly digital experiences and integrations.

Screenshots.Caption: A card per Document Type, in a district for each root beside Compositions, Elements and Unreachable, with lines for allowed children, compositions, block targets and picker references.
Each card shows its icon, name, property count and a size bar with a segment per property group.
Focus on one type and its neighbours, with the inspector open on its properties and connections.
Findings grouped by kind, with breakages first. Each row names its evidence and opens the type it is about.
Mark a finding as intentional with a reason. It reopens if the type changes.
Colour the cards by content count, published share, cultures, incoming references or unused types.
Impact lists every type a change reaches, with paths, content counts and alias collisions.
Compare two schema snapshots, grouped by cause, with planned changes ticked off.
A block editor Data Type with the Element Types it offers and the blocks content stores of each.
The creation tree shows what editors can create under each root, and the types they cannot reach.
Types crossed with compositions, or with Data Types.
A Document Type laid out in tabs and groups, the way editors see it.
Every type in a sortable table.
Presentation mode for showing the schema to a room.
And for fun: the same schema as a glowing 3D city.
